entities.name: Query protein 274 aa
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A1SJZ1 from Nocardioides sp.; sequence length 274 aa.
Contains Pfam BacA domain PF02673.25 spanning residues 7–261 with i-Evalue 2.2e-85.
Highly hydrophobic sequence-derived profile: GRAVY 0.7839, consistent with a compact multi-pass membrane protein.

entities.name: A1SJZ1 undecaprenyl-diphosphatase
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Nocardioides sp. strain ATCC BAA-499 / JS614.
Catalyzes dephosphorylation of undecaprenyl diphosphate (UPP) to undecaprenyl phosphate.
Annotated as a cell-membrane, multi-pass membrane protein.

entities.name: BacA membrane topology
observations: The 274-residue sequence is dominated by hydrophobic segments, supporting multiple membrane-spanning helices and integral membrane localization.
Exact-match reference annotation classifies the protein as a multi-pass cell-membrane protein.

entities.name: Undecaprenyl phosphate cycle
observations: Undecaprenyl diphosphate dephosphorylation produces undecaprenyl phosphate, a lipid carrier used in bacterial cell-envelope biogenesis.
The associated biological process is bacterial cell-envelope precursor recycling; the provided annotation directly supports UPP phosphatase activity.
